decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component spraying system extends the firm's core two-component spraying know-how into corrosion-protection coatings, so the firm can readily interpret field results and refine it.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established offer, was field-tested on construction sites before launch, and has its own page, which signals strong learning and commitment.
This multi-model transfer pump line reuses the proven WIWA air motors, so it builds directly on existing knowledge and production capabilities.

Fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat further from core pump know-how but supports the firm's digitalization goals, has a dedicated page, and can be improved through its R&D and university cooperation.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched only recently and lies close to the firm's core competence, so it is too early and too well aligned to drop.
